verification.detail: Root strict TypeScript and STAS typecheck pass with the production ProjectionProcessor integration.
The actual ProjectionProcessor and local CRS/Geometry adapters reject invalid geometry after SELECT but before every current-state mutation; the transaction issues ROLLBACK and releases its client.
The script reached PostgreSQL but authentication failed with SQLSTATE 28P01. The isolated P00 credential was unavailable; no write was attempted.

acceptance.evidence: Production ProjectionProcessor calls H3PgLocalAdapter through a transaction-local factory for R7-R10; source-boundary tests prove no H3 HTTP, Gateway, or Provider client exists on this path.

A controlled integration invokes the real ProjectionProcessor and local adapters with invalid self-intersecting geometry, observes FOUNDATION_GEOMETRY_INVALID, no state mutation query, and transaction rollback.
The only local policy is REJECT; forced MAKE_VALID policy fails closed and invalid input is not mutated.

ProjectionProcessor atomically inserts Geometry, CRS, and H3 operation/method/input/output hashes and Compute Snapshots through migration 012; live PostgreSQL execution is BLOCKED by unavailable credentials.
A focused outage test proves canonical 4326 processing performs zero remote calls; a full live ingest/projection outage test remains outstanding.
